bugs_found: apply_fee computes fee as fee_pct squared instead of amount * fee_pct, causing systematically wrong charges/refunds
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int(), changing financial results without error
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int(), changing amortization results without error
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal; float or non-Decimal inputs can pass checks then fail at arithmetic
transfer is not atomic: debit is applied before credit, so a failure during credit update can leave accounts inconsistent
